layers.name: Rain
layers.text: drops fall 5–9 m/s; wide spectrum from the spread of drop sizes + turbulence

layers.name: Melting layer
layers.text: bright band: wet snowflakes look like huge water drops → Z peak; fall speed jumps as flakes collapse into raindrops

layers.name: Snow / ice
layers.text: snow / ice crystals fall slowly (~1 m/s); narrow spectrum, weaker Z

layers.name: Altostratus
layers.text: cloud droplets barely fall; Z < 0 dBZ, usually below the sensitivity of a low-power radar

scenarios.label: Baseline
scenarios.hint: PA 20 dBm, ADMV1014 without LNA, 8 dwells (0.1 s)

scenarios.label: + LNA, 0.4 s
scenarios.hint: adds a 3 dB-NF LNA and averages 32 dwells
